request.description: Create a FRESH FROM-SCRATCH simplified BASE DESIGN of ANDROMOSS, a lean adult extraterrestrial trickster from Andromeda living in a moonlit garden. Much simpler and cleaner than the reference. Remove sunglasses completely: give him TWO LARGE WIDE-OPEN EXPRESSIVE EYES with simple broad pale eye shapes and dark readable pupils, a curious mischievous alert look. Eyes can be large WITHIN a NORMAL-SIZED ADULT HEAD: do NOT enlarge the skull or make a balloon/baby/chibi head. Keep slender adult body and long legs. His small short crown points are RIGID SKIN, one continuous surface with forehead, not hair/cap and no dividing hairline. Two simple bold neck gill marks, a slender lion-like tail with a tiny compact tip tuft. REMOVE hook, chain, rear braid/ponytail and tiny outfit details. Bare simple three-finger alien hands held naturally. Plain dark short jacket over one flat-color shirt, simple trousers/boots; no zippers, studs, buckles, seams, jewelry or equipment. Use few big readable shapes, thick consistent dark outlines, broad flat clean clusters, ONLY 2 shades per material and a tight palette. Preserve alien skin-color family from reference1 but redesign freely rather than tracing old pose/art. Match approved knight's clean adult pixel style and final game art. No white/light-gray noise, tiny isolated highlights, texture, dithering, gradients or magical particles. Full body and tail fit inside transparent 192x192 with generous animation margins, relaxed standing three-quarter facing slightly left. No scenery, writing, props or effects.

reference_images.usage: Alien species/anatomy and skin-color family only: normal adult head, skin-continuous crown, neck gills and slender tail. Do NOT copy sunglasses, hook/chain, rear braid, outfit detail or rendering. Draw a simpler new character from scratch with large exposed eyes.
Bold dark outlines and simple clean broad flat clusters of the final mole/rabbit/star/board art. Style only, not species or props.
